shouldFix.title: The terminal-review gate remains open to statusless non-legacy files and unrecognized verdict values
evidence: terminalStatusCheck says that whenever both reviewStatus and reviewState are absent, 'the file is a legacy verdict-only schema' and is eligible on verdict alone. The parenthetical names Claude/Codex v8, Claude v10, and Claude v12, but no predicate requires the candidate path to equal one of those four exact legacy paths. A current or future review can therefore omit both members and take the legacy branch while its path, digest, verdict, extractor schema, and registered findings all pass the other checks.

verdictConsistencyCheck states only two implications: recorded ACCEPT forbids BLOCKER/SHOULD-FIX, and recorded REJECT requires one. It never requires the pinned or registered verdict to be a string in the closed set {ACCEPT, REJECT}. A review with reviewStatus COMPLETE and verdict PENDING, paired with a register verdict PENDING and any recognized finding schema, satisfies exact verdict equality and is outside both consistency clauses, so no stated check refuses it.

These are direct countermodels to honestyRepairsFromV20, which claims current schemas require COMPLETE and that ACCEPT/REJECT is consistent. The mechanical text neither limits the no-status exception to the named frozen legacy files nor makes ACCEPT/REJECT exhaustive.

The live v20 data is sound: both frozen reviews reproduce, are COMPLETE REJECT, contain one SHOULD-FIX each, and v21 registers their exact verdicts and complete (id, severity) sets. That bounds the defect to SHOULD-FIX rather than a blocker.
shouldFix.impact: A successor can register an unfinished current review or a terminal file with a non-decision verdict while every governing provenance, extraction, pair, disposition, and repair-ledger check passes. Later consumers can mistake that register entry for eligible frozen review custody even though the standing ACCEPT/REJECT gate was never reached.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Make terminalStatusCheck's no-status fallback an exact allowlist keyed by the four named legacy paths and their frozen digests; every other current or future review must carry a present terminal COMPLETE/COMPLETED status. Close verdict eligibility to exactly ACCEPT or REJECT before consistency checking, then require ACCEPT iff there are zero BLOCKER and zero SHOULD-FIX findings and REJECT iff at least one exists. Any other verdict type or value MUST refuse.
